Name: Ginger Shot Valley
Author: ZeltronCurry
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Adds a Ginger Shot cooking recipe to the Island Trader. It's good for immunity![/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download SMAPI, Content Patcher, and this mod, drag them into your mods folder. Extra Machine Configs mod is technically not needed, but it helps the mod visually.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Adds a Ginger Shot item you can cook, giving you some great buffs for a short time.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI, Content Patcher, preferably Extra Machine Configs.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Biggest shoutout to SiTheGreat1 for making the Modder's Pie mod. Thanks![/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I would like to thank nerpaderp for designing the item sprite, Nullnnow for troubleshooting and basic help, Cackling Caracal for basic help and support, Selph for troubleshooting and help, [/size]firedlily for support and help and radium for helping me. Thanks guys![/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Changelog[/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]1.0.1 Added ginger_item context tag to the ginger shot item. Can now cure nausea and makes it compatible with other mods (e. g. shopkeepers buy more items)[/color]
